events.headline: EXPLOSION ON RUSSIAN SHIP AT LIBYA PORT CAUSED BY SUSPECTED DRONE ATTACK, OFFICI
events.detail: Libya's eastern government says the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.

events.headline: UNA EXPLOSIÓN HUNDE UN BARCO DE GUERRA RUSO EN LA COSTA ORIENTAL DE LIBIA
events.detail: Las autoridades locales informan de que el hundimiento pudo ser causado por un ataque con drones. Ucrania no ha asumido por el momento la autoría

events.headline: UN BUQUE RUSO FUE BLANCO DE UN PRESUNTO ATAQUE CON DRONES EN LIBIA MIENTRAS OTRO
events.detail: La explosión ocurrió en una base naval del puerto de Bengasi y dejó varios heridos; continúan las tareas para controlar el incendio a bordo otro carguero ruso anclado en aguas finlandesas

events.headline: SUSPECTED DRONE ATTACK CAUSES EXPLOSION ON RUSSIAN SHIP IN LIBYA
events.detail: A Russian ship has been struck in a suspected drone attack while docked at Libya’s Benghazi naval base.

events.headline: RUSSIA-BOUND SHIP TOWED AWAY AFTER IT WAS ATTACKED IN GULF OF FINLAND
events.detail: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone strike on Saturday. Kyiv has yet to comment.

events.headline: RUSSIAN VESSEL HIT BY SUSPECTED UKRAINIAN DRONE AT LIBYA’S BENGHAZI PORT
events.detail: There was no immediate reaction from Russia, and no one has claimed responsibility for the suspected attack.
